title: The Dimension of the Two-Adic Hecke Algebra at Odd Level
main_claim: For odd N, every irreducible component of Spec T_2(N) (the full 2-adic prime-to-2N Hecke algebra on modular forms of all weights at level Gamma_1(N)) has Krull dimension exactly 4 (Emerton's Conjecture 2.9 at p=2).

issues.location: Theorem 2.4 (Emerton's lower bound, cited as [Emerton11, Cor. 2.28])
issues.description: The lower bound dim >= 4 is used as a black box at p=2. The paper re-proves the p=2 Noetherianity (pseudodeformation) input to Emerton's Thm 2.7 via Chenevier determinants. It does not check that the other inputs to Cor. 2.28 (eigencurve / infinite-fern geometry, Jochnowitz finiteness in Prop 2.8) hold at p=2. This is a dependency the paper does not verify, not a demonstrated error.
issues.evidence: The paper itself says Emerton's Theorem 2.7 had references with an odd-prime restriction and fixes only that step. Corollary 3.2 and the final count both depend on dim V(P) >= 4.

coverage: Read the full LaTeX source (806 lines). Checked: finite-stage embeddings and Zariski density; the quadratic-law construction of the integral determinant; Noetherianity via Chenevier's universal determinant ring and Mazur's condition at 2, with surjectivity by density and compactness; the Eisenstein interpolation map Phi via the graph closure (evaluation continuity, x_i in 4Z_2, Strassmann injectivity; recovering X from (1+X)^{b_l} with l = 1 mod N, l = 5 mod 8) and the resulting dim B = 2; Corollary 3.2 (open-set argument, so the classical point found is cuspidal of weight >= 3); Prop 4.1 (coefficient field, continuity of derivations through finite R/x^2, Chenevier Thm 2.22 lifting, continuity of r_D through the trace Gram matrix, cocycle-to-trace map, injectivity via 2d = t^2 - t(g^2) in characteristic 0); the CM exclusion (the CM field is unramified at 2, and the quadratic subfields of Q(zeta_{2^inf}) all ramify at 2); H^0(V*(1)) = 0 locally (Hodge-Tate weight gap k-1 >= 2 at 2; genericity plus Carayol away from 2); the local quotients (0 at v != 2 by the Euler characteristic and unramified counting; 3 at 2 by 4 - 1, with D_dR/Fil^0 of the adjoint having dimension 1); the global injection into local quotients given vanishing H^1_f; and the catenary formula dim A/P = ht(x/P) + 1 <= 3 + 1. Newton-Thorne Thm 5.4 and Emerton Cor 2.28 were not re-verified against their sources.
sibling_notes: Both siblings in family 010 (Fontaine-Mazur-modularity-at-2 and Unrestricted-pro-modularity-at-2) use this paper's Thm 1.1 (dim-4 components) as a black box. This paper cites neither of them, so there is no circularity.
